name: C4 Code Diagram (Level 4)
description: C4 Code Diagram (Level 4) describes in detail the entity classes inside a component. Equivalent to UML Class Diagram but in the context of the C4 model — goes deep into attributes, methods, and relationships between classes.
purpose: Detail entities in the domain model, connecting C4 architecture design to actual code.
bestFor: Detail entities in the domain model
Create documentation for developers implementing code
notSuitableFor: Describe component overview → go back to Level 3 (Component)
Describe container → go back to Level 2 (Container)
Describe system overview → go back to Level 1 (Context)
useCases: Identify entity classes in the component

confusableWith.difference: C4 Code is a Class Diagram in the context of the C4 model — same notation, different context.
